description: Search the draw.io shape library by keywords. Returns matching shapes with their exact style strings, dimensions, and titles. Covers ~10,000 built-in stencils (cloud architecture, network topology, P&ID, electrical, Cisco, Kubernetes, BPMN) and, when those are sparse, supplements results with the draw.io icon service (brand/product logos and general-purpose concept icons, e.g. 'react', 'slack', 'shopping cart', 'solar panel'). Use ONLY for diagrams that need industry-specific, branded, or pictorial icons. Do NOT use for standard diagram types like flowcharts, UML, ERD, org charts, or mind maps — these use basic geometric shapes (rectangles, diamonds, circles, cylinders) that are already covered in the XML reference. Also skip if the user asks to use basic/simple shapes or says not to search. The style string from the results can be used directly in mxCell style attributes.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

query.description: Space-separated search keywords (e.g. 'pid globe valve', 'aws lambda', 'cisco router', 'kubernetes pod')

name: search_shapes

shapes.description: Matching shapes, best match first — empty when nothing matched the query.

style.description: mxCell style string, usable verbatim in a style attribute

title: Search Shapes
